key_concepts: Force is a push or pull.
Force occurs when two or more objects interact.
Applying force can change an object's shape.
Applying force can change an object's size.
Force can make a resting object move.
Force can make a moving object stop.
Force can change the direction of a moving object.
Force can change how fast or slow an object moves.
